exposure: Early onset sepsis vs. late onset sepsis
cohort: 125 neonates (from birth till 28 days) admitted with clinical signs and symptoms of presumed sepsis
finding: Gram-negative bacteria were more frequent in early onset sepsis and normal vaginal delivery cases, while gram-positive bacteria were more common in late onset sepsis and C-section delivery cases.
mod_finding: Gram-negative organisms were more frequent in early onset sepsis and normal vaginal delivery (NVD) cases in contrast to gram positive being more common in late onset sepsis and C-section delivery cases respectively.
